specs.scope: Lounge & Bar Interior Design, Lighting Moods & 3D Visualization

title: The Hamlet
excerpt: A 2018 interior design and 3D visualization commission for The Hamlet, Nest's twenty-residence luxury development in Cantonments, Accra.

specs.scope: Interior Design & 3D Visualization (Modeling & Rendering)
specs.team: Jude Nyoagbe, Jude Abbey, Nana Afua Addo Boateng

title: The Parker
excerpt: A 2012 exterior visualization set for the Parker, a mid-rise block designed by Eugene Nelson-Addy: three rendered views of a curved, cream-panelled building with tall glazed bays gathered on orange fins, its floors lit from within.

specs.scope: Architectural visualization: three exterior views of the Parker — the dusk elevation, the glazed entrance court and the street parking approach.

title: The Saddle
excerpt: The Saddle is a 2018 concept design and visualization by RDVS Studio, a proposal for a real estate company showing low residential pavilions set on a hillside below a forested ridge, published as one black-and-white image.

specs.scope: Concept design of the hillside pavilion scheme and one finished 3D visualization plate, modelled, lit and post-produced in monochrome for the pitch.

title: The SEED
excerpt: The first version of the studio's seed device, published in October 2009 as a desktop wallpaper: a fan of hairline filaments rising from a sown seed into a dark green comma crowned by a concentric target of white, light green, yellow, orange and red, set almost alone on a white field. The post carries no text at all, so the single plate here is that file and the studio's three labels are the only words ever written about it.

specs.scope: A single desktop wallpaper artwork, self-published by the studio.

title: The Tea House
excerpt: An identity system and bespoke UI/UX web platform for The Tea House, a tea room and event venue in Accra: a leaf mark in two greens, ochre display type and a set of organic overlapping shapes carried across the site's story, menu, booking and reservation flows.

specs.scope: Brand identity system, graphic design and custom UI/UX web design — art direction, menu, booking and reservation flows
specs.team: Jude Abbey, Jude Nyoagbe, Mahalia, Bimpong

title: Tower Cascades
excerpt: Interior design and CGI for Hawkrad Properties: thirty-three visualisation plates, an animation film and a VR walkthrough covering the Tower Cascades apartments and their shared amenities — the lobby, reception, roof-terrace lounge and fitness floor — made to be used as marketing material for the development.

specs.scope: Interior design and CGI — still renders, an animation film and a VR walkthrough — produced as marketing material for the development; architecture by ArchXenus

title: Trumpet Africa Productions Ident
excerpt: The sole objective for this project is to create a short length logo animation to be used as an ident in motion picture projects produced by Trumpet Africa Productions.

specs.scope: Concept Development, Storyboarding, Illustrations, Motion Design & 3D Animation

title: TSIK
excerpt: TSIK is a 2009 identity RDVS built for a Ghanaian construction company, in which the logo is not drawn but modelled: a lattice of rounded white cubes with orange wireframe running through the gaps, standing over a dark band that carries the wordmark.

specs.scope: Identity design: a modelled and rendered cube mark with orange wireframe, and the wordmark and strapline band.

title: TTD
excerpt: Expansive residential interior suite for D - TWO, encompassing living, dining, and custom culinary spaces.

specs.scope: Full Interior Architecture, Joinery Detailing & 40 3D Visualization Plates

title: Viasat1 Breakfast Show
excerpt: A 2013 broadcast branding pitch by RDVS. DESIGN for the breakfast show on Viasat 1, built from a coffee-cup logotype, a teal and yellow palette, a typeface sheet and a storyboarded set of morning-routine film frames.

specs.scope: Concept and identity design for the programme, covering logotype, colour palette, typeface specification, on-screen graphics and idents, and a storyboarded animated opening sequence.

title: VI
excerpt: Four interior visualization plates from 2013 for an apartment on Victoria Island, Lagos, made for a Nigerian architectural firm: a calm living room shown from three cameras plus its kitchen, as interior design and 3D visualization.

specs.scope: Interior design of the living room and kitchen scheme, styling of the views, and four finished 3D visualization plates with title and credit overlays.

title: Villa Aggregate
excerpt: Interior design and architectural visualization for Villa Aggregate, a four-bedroom family house in a fast-developing part of Accra, planned for a modern Ghanaian family and carried through sixteen plates in 2021.

specs.scope: Interior design and architectural visualization, rendered to support the developer's sales drive

title: Villagio Vista
excerpt: Villagio Vista is a 2015 in-house photography experiment: nine plates drawn from just three exposures of a pixel-clad residential development, one of them a thirty-second night frame cropped six different ways.

specs.scope: Self-initiated architectural photography of a residential development: one daylight frame published in colour and monochrome, one daylight detail, and one thirty-second night frame cropped into six plates.

title: Vodafone Red Hse
excerpt: A Red House exhibition booth for Vodafone, designed with Steven Ntow in July 2011 and presented on one proposal sheet — the brand lockup and the corner of the stand set side by side.

specs.scope: Exhibition booth design: the stand's louvered corner and glazed frontage, its signage and brand application, and the Red House wordmark lockup.

title: Watson's Place
excerpt: Five interior design and visualization plates from 2016 for Watson's Place, a residential block in Accra: lounge, dining and bedroom interiors made as marketing material, then two street views of the grey, stone and orange facade.

specs.scope: Interior design and 3D visualization for property marketing: two street-facing exterior views and lounge, dining and bedroom interior renders.

title: Weldment Panels
excerpt: Renders of a graffiti-proof wall panel system, made in 2016 as part of a client's presentation material.

specs.scope: 3D modelling of the panel cladding and the road structures it is fixed to, rendered in daylight, dusk and night lighting for a client presentation.

title: Wellness House
excerpt: Wellness House is a conceptual architectural design RDVS developed in 2010 for a site in Tema, Greater Accra: a low single-storey pavilion organized around a long water courtyard and shaded by one deep overhanging roof.

specs.scope: Conceptual architectural design of a single-storey pavilion for a site in Tema: massing, elevation and courtyard studies carried from a bare white model through to material, colour and lighting studies.

title: West Cantonments Residence
excerpt: A 2018 interior design and 3D visualization commission for Infinite Group Ltd, presenting the shared amenity interiors of the West Cantonments development in Accra.

specs.scope: Interior Design & 3D Visualization (Modeling & Rendering)

title: West Hills Mall
excerpt: West Hills Mall is a 2015 in-house photograph of the mall's upper clerestory, published on Behance twice over: the same exposure once in colour and once re-graded to monochrome, tagged 010 and 009.

specs.scope: Self-initiated architectural photography of West Hills Mall: one interior view shot, re-graded, and published in colour and monochrome.

title: White and Unassuming
excerpt: Five renders of a white two-storey house the studio published in May 2009 as its latest job: a kitchen, a study, a bedroom and a double-height living room, and the street elevation that explains the title. The post says the house was still to be built, somewhere in Tema.

specs.scope: Interior design and 3D visualization of a house proposed at Tema: kitchen, study, bedroom and double-height living room rendered, with the street elevation.

title: White Fleece
excerpt: A 2014 corporate identity for White Fleece, a business in Accra, in which RDVS Studios designed a teal wave-and-orbit logotype and built out a full stationery suite, colour system and brand wallpaper.

specs.scope: Brand identity design, logotype and variations, letterhead, business card, corporate typeface specification, brand wallpaper and a laptop mockup.

title: White House
excerpt: Monolithic white residential concept emphasizing geometric massing, deep solar reveals, and shaded terraces.

specs.scope: Concept Architecture, Volumetric Studies & Photoreal Visualization

title: Yah!
excerpt: A 2016 interior design, graphic design and 3D visualization set for yah!, a new bakery and cafe in Kumasi Mall, Ghana, built on white space, a black Chinese dragon mural and a magenta brand punch.

specs.scope: Interior design, graphic identity and 3D visualization for the outlet, covering the seating hall, service counter, wall murals, signage and storefront.

title: Yakubu Interiors
excerpt: Five interior renderings made for INCEPT Ltd in November 2008, when the studio was working as a team-up: the entrance hall of a house seen twice, from the floor and from the stair landing, then its kitchen, living room and bedroom, all dressed in pale tiles, ochre walls and dark timber.

specs.scope: Five interior visualizations of a house: the entrance hall seen from the floor and from the stair landing, plus the kitchen, living room and bedroom.
specs.team: Kwahmi//studios, acethetics studios and PXL PPL, teamed up as Revival, for INCEPT Ltd

title: Yao + Yaa
excerpt: Wedding invite for Yao Tettey and Yaa Lamptey, built on a single sea-green paisley field with the couple's day-names worked into it tone-on-tone.

specs.client: Nunya Yao Tettey & Rebecca Yaa Effaah Lamptey
specs.scope: Graphic Design, Illustration, Digital Art & Print

title: YCM
excerpt: Two poster designs for the Youth Christian Movement's "Yoked in Christ" gathering — three days of praise, worship, quiz and debate at the Chapel of Grace in Houston, Texas, 25 to 27 May 2012.

specs.scope: Poster design for a three-day youth gathering: two colour treatments of one information architecture, from the theme line to the programme and venue.

title: Zipnet Takoradi
excerpt: A 2011 interior design and visualization set for Zipnet's office in Takoradi: six rendered views covering an executive office, a boardroom, an open-plan engineers' floor and a reception, the last shown once in daylight and once after dark.

specs.scope: Interior visualization of six views across the Zipnet office — the executive office in two angles, the boardroom, the open-plan engineers' floor and the reception in day and night lighting.

title: 1H
excerpt: A wall run built from modules rather than one fixed elevation: open bays and closed volumes re-stack around a screen at eye level. RDVS designed 1H in 2016 for the MIG line and documented it in two schemes, a dark-stained set stacked as a tall bay and a white-and-dark set run wider across the wall.

title: HG-DESK
excerpt: A work desk built around one thick top with a returned edge carrying the MIG mark, set on angled trestle supports. Designed by RDVS in 2020 for the MIG line.

title: LINE E FLOAT I
excerpt: A media unit carried off the floor on the wall, so the floor below it stays clear and the screen reads as the only thing in the run. Shown in blush against a two-tone wall, and in white under a matching shelf.

title: MLKY
excerpt: An experimental lighting range rather than one fixture: a reeded column that lifts a room from the floor, a cluster of rounded diffusers that reads as a single body, and a corrugated trunk tapering from a thin tip to an open mouth. RDVS designed MLKY in 2021 for the MIG line.

title: MOUND
excerpt: The plate labels MOUND as accessories for fruit and clutter: a shallow tray for what collects on a surface, and a mesh-top bench doing the same job at a larger scale at the foot of a bed. Designed by RDVS in 2016 for the MIG line.

title: S-AGE
excerpt: A curved front-of-house desk in white, its plain panel carrying an information-desk pictogram. Designed by RDVS in 2018 for the MIG line.

title: SP001
excerpt: A low pod for a power nap at work, deep enough to hold some privacy. Designed by RDVS in 2019 for the MIG line, and given here lit on black, dressed with pillows, and exploded so the slatted top and the hardwood frame read separately.
